items.title: Building Self-Service into Terraform: Introducing Terraform Developer Portal (Public Preview)
items.summary: Terraform Developer Portal (TDP) makes governed self-service a native capability of HCP Terraform, helping platform teams define approved infrastructure patterns that developers and agents can easily consume.

items.title: Terraform advances infrastructure lifecycle management for the agentic era
items.summary: New Terraform capabilities bring trusted infrastructure context, governed self-service, and connected intelligence to infrastructure workflows for humans and AI agents.
